question: India's first airport based self-powered indoor air quality monitoring facility 'Pavana Chitra' was unveiled at which airport in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram International Airport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first airport-based self-powered indoor air quality monitoring facility, named **'Pavana Chitra'**, was unveiled at Thiruvananthapuram International Airport in October 2024.
 
• The facility operates using **renewable energy sources**, reflecting the airport's commitment to environmental sustainability.
 
• 'Pavana Chitra' monitors indoor air quality parameters such as **PM2.5, PM10, carbon dioxide, and other pollutants**, ensuring a healthy environment for passengers and staff.
 
• This innovative project aligns with India's broader environmental goals and efforts to enhance passenger experience at airports.
 
• Thiruvananthapuram International Airport is among India's prominent airports, known for its advanced technology and eco-friendly initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chennai International Airport:**
 
 
• Chennai International Airport is one of India's busiest airports, serving as a major hub for international and domestic flights.
 
• The airport has undertaken several modernization projects, including the installation of advanced baggage handling systems and terminal upgrades.
 
• It has implemented eco-friendly measures such as solar power usage, water recycling, and energy-efficient lighting systems.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru International Airport:**
 
 
• Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru is India's first airport to use a **100% renewable energy** source for its operations.
 
• The airport is known for its sustainability initiatives, such as rainwater harvesting and waste management systems.
 
• It has received accolades for its passenger-centric services and innovative technologies, including AI-driven baggage management.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur International Airport:**
 
 
• Jaipur International Airport is a key gateway to Rajasthan, offering connectivity to major cities in India and abroad.
 
• The airport has implemented energy-efficient lighting and solar power systems to reduce its carbon footprint.
 
• Although it has sustainable practices, it has not yet introduced indoor air quality monitoring facilities like 'Pavana Chitra.'
 
 
 
• **Theme of the Question:**
 
 
• The question emphasizes the importance of indoor air quality monitoring in public spaces, especially airports, to ensure passenger safety and comfort.
 
• Airports are increasingly adopting renewable energy-based systems and technologies to meet environmental standards and reduce operational costs.
 
• Such initiatives contribute to India's commitment to sustainability and reducing the impact of climate change.
